ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; approximately 85-90% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels with 10-15% high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels primarily located at the outer margins and right medial lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white blobs at the distal left tip; distinct white linear streaks and focal spots mapped to the medial-central portion of the right lobe; white highlights along the lower trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with an estimated internal angle of 70 degrees and a vertical depth comprising approximately 12% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations; sharp pixel peaks (approx. 5-15 pixel amplitude) distributed continuously along the trailing edge from notch to distal tips, creating a highly irregular boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve leading to sharply pointed, dorsally-swept distal tips; overall lobe shape is narrow and elongate with a steep upward trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast clusters of white and brownish pixels (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) concentrated at the extreme distal points of both fluke lobes, consistent with barnacle-related scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 3-4 parallel, high-contrast white linear disruptions (approx. 40-60 pixels in length) on the medial right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive white rake marks (parallel linear scars) on the right lobe; irregular, potentially traumatic tissue loss at the distal tip of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The trailing edge exhibits an exceptionally jagged topography with deeper-than-average serrations compared to typical species morphological standards.
